info.title: مکتب‌یار (MaktabYar) API
info.description: REST API for the Afghan school management information system. All endpoints are versioned under /api/v1, authenticated with an HttpOnly session cookie (web) and enforce role+scope permissions server-side. Errors use a consistent envelope with Dari messages. State-changing requests require the x-maktabyar-client header or a same-origin Origin header (CSRF defense).
